title: Constructive Algebraic, Guarded-Shift, and Newton-Reduction Certificates for the 1/2 Logarithmic Exponent of Integer Multiplication on Tapes
abstract: We present TAPE-INT-MULT-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification engine and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing the finite-dimensional algebraic, bit-packing, triangular Chinese-remainder, borrowed-workspace chirp, Newton/Brent arithmetic, sunflower 3-SAT, and wire-price mechanisms of OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'The logarithmic exponent of integer multiplication on tapes' (Theorems 1.1, 1.2, 5.1, 7.1, and 8.1). Without claiming to formalize Turing-machine tape-parking schedules, Baker-Harman-Pintz prime-gap selection, or infinite-dimensional CAT(0) ultralimits end-to-end, we construct a four-mode exact verifier over Z, Q, and F_p backed by 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings). Across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we audit (i) Lemma 3.1's eight-shift guarded low-bit XOR bijection on 2^{2G} address pairs (G in {6,7}), Sec. 2.4 odd-characteristic spectral swap diagonalization, and Cor. 3.2 two-involution cycle decompositions, (ii) Sec. 5.2 Eq. (5.3) triangular scaled-residue CRT bijections with exact cyclic-convolution integer products and Lemma 3.3 (2d-1)-stage Benes bit-flip schedules, (iii) Lemma 5.2 exact borrowed-workspace chirp conjugation (D_1 (+) I)B^{-1}(D_2 (+) I)B(D_3 (+) I)=U_a (+) I and Cor. 6.1-6.2 exact Newton reciprocal/square-root and Brent division/floor-sqrt multiplication reductions, and (iv) Theorem 7.1 sunflower 3-SAT branching equivalence with exact #SAT contractions and Lemmas 8.2-8.3/Theorem 8.1 Euclidean barycenter wire-price bounds with rationalized gap 1-rho > 1/sqrt(2). All 16 certificates, 68 unit/forgery tests, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
